e: The correct answer is Custody Stores. The common feature is that their cost has already been charged off to the final head, so they do not form part of priced stock.

q: Materials obtained for specific works should be kept outside the accounts of any other category of stores,which were separately requisitioned by Engineer; temporarily held at charge of a sub-head of a work and yet to be consumed is known as

It represents stock at the work site awaiting use, chargeable to that work when consumed. Exam distinction: this is different from stock (central depots) and from imprest stores (maintenance imprest).

Exam fact: surplus stores remain Railway property and are normally returned to stock or re-issued to other works, with credit given to the work from which they were released.
